siteDescription: Independent creative shop based in Usingen, Germany, specialising in personalised gifts, 3D-printed products, custom name signs, flexi animal toys, children's room decorations and playful home decor.
writingSample: Prints by Eri creates thoughtful, personalised and playful products for birthdays, Christmas, baby celebrations, housewarmings, anniversaries and family milestones. From our workshop in Usingen, Germany, we design and prepare personalised name signs, custom decorations, flexi animal toys, seasonal gifts and practical decorative products for homes and families. We combine digital design with 3D printing to create distinctive products that feel more personal than standard mass-produced gifts. Each personalised order is prepared carefully, with attention to the customer’s selected design and personalisation details, and checked before packing. Our goal is to create well-designed, personal and joyful products that customers are happy to give, display and use.
